# hackathon-entry-template

> Generic hackathon entry template: README skeleton (problem, solution, architecture, what was built), docs/SUBMISSION.md checklist, .env.example, and CI that scans for secrets and auto-detects Node, Python or Foundry to build and test.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/hackathon-entry-template/main/README.md): overview, install and the 'Use as a building block' section
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/hackathon-entry-template/main/AGENTS.md): setup, build/test commands, structure map, conventions and rules for AI coding agents
- [blocks.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/hackathon-entry-template/main/blocks.json): machine-readable building-block manifest (entrypoints, inputs, outputs, deps, compatible blocks)

## Key files

- [README.md](https://github.com/Blockchains/hackathon-entry-template/blob/main/README.md): skeleton
- [docs/SUBMISSION.md](https://github.com/Blockchains/hackathon-entry-template/blob/main/docs/SUBMISSION.md): checklist
- [.github/workflows/ci.yml](https://github.com/Blockchains/hackathon-entry-template/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml): CI

## Related

- [Build with Blocks](https://github.com/Blockchains/.github/blob/main/docs/BUILD-WITH-BLOCKS.md): how to assemble projects from Blockchains repos

- [Blockchains/hackathons](https://github.com/Blockchains/hackathons): link the tracker issue in the README header
- [Blockchains/blockchainlab-starters](https://github.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-starters): start the code from a starter
